BiblicalUsage: Four times, and always at the edge of the day. When the sun went down and it was dark, the smoking furnace and burning lamp passed between the pieces of Abraham's covenant. And Ezekiel is told to dig through the wall and carry his stuff out in the twilight, a sign of an exile leaving under cover of dark.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for dusk carries no theology of its own; its weight is the hour it marks, that God's covenant was cut after dark and His prophet acted out an exile's flight at twilight.
